name: vstack
description: Personal agent skills: autonomous-merge (review, fix and babysit a PR to ready, or merged only when asked to merge, within caps), babysit (shepherd a PR to green or merged), html-plan (interactive HTML implementation plans), pr-writing (PR descriptions that summarise the change, with a small diagram for complex ones, plus replies to reviewers and PR comments that read like a person wrote them), review (read-only multi-lens code review within a hard reviewer budget) and remove-comments (strictly delete comment noise, with a check that no code changed).
